BJP forms panel to help with civil code rollout, sets August timeline

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has formed a panel to assist with the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code in West Bengal, aiming to complete the process by August. The move comes amid efforts to introduce the draft UCC bill in the state. This development is part of the BJP's efforts to promote Hindu law and values across India.
